title: The 6 Types of "Jack-Of-All-Trades" People That Make Millions
description:
You're a multi-hyphenate --- what do you do with that? Start here 👇

https://cs.copyhackers.com/ = how to become a copywriter

Yes, a copywriter! Here's why having too many interests could make you one of the best copywriters of our time. See, in this video, you're learning about the six archetypes of people with quote-unquote too many interests. Each one of them actually maps to the exact cognitive profile of a great conversion copywriter. Check out just three of the six to see what I mean:  

👀 If you're a Master of Synthesis, you can rock psych + design + data, all of which killer copywriters do daily...

👀 If you're a Pattern Hunter, you see the system behind every funnel and the throughlines in voice-of-customer data, which means you can find the message and stick the landing...

👀 If you're a Talent Stacker -- I mean, Scott Adams is THE copywriter origin story. 

Copywriting isn't just a place multi-passionate people can go. It's arguably the only commercial discipline that pays you more the more domains you can hold at once. 

Look, if you're remotely curious about finding your way as a conversion copywriter - who works with tons of brands selling tons of products to tons of audiences (all of which YOU GET TO BE INTERESTED IN!), start with this book and see if it fits with your, ahem, interests: 

https://copysellingbook.com/
